name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 39 – Am 72
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 39b. Recalls that some Member States have implemented effective border-protection systems against illegal migration; condemns the fact that this effort is punished by the politically biased Commission and Court of Justice of the EU; calls for the EU institutions to abandon the Pact on Migration and Asylum or grant an opt-out from the pact to the Member States;
